info.title: LEPIC wallet API
info.description: The owner API of `lepic serve`, on its Unix socket, and the payment endpoint of `lepic serve --http`. Response bodies are the JSON `lepic --output json` prints. Amounts are decimal strings in EPIC.

get.description:
A server-sent event stream: each event's `event` field is its `kind` and its `data` line
is the event as JSON. A client that falls behind gets a `lagged` event saying how many it
missed, and the stream goes on.

default.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details

post.description:
JSON-RPC 2.0 as other Epic wallets post it, answered by the listener `serve --http`
adds, with its own limits and no authentication. `build_coinbase` is answered only
with `--coinbase`. The wire format is the network's.

fees.description: The block's fees in base units, as a number or decimal text.

height.description: The block's height, as a number or decimal text.

key_id.description: The key id to build with, hex; the wallet picks one when absent.

BuildCoinbaseRequest.description: Build the coinbase output and kernel of a block a miner works on.

params.description: By name, or by position as a one-element array.

CheckVersionRequest.description: The API version and the slate versions this wallet reads.

EventReport.description:
One engine event. `kind` names it, as does the event's SSE `event` field; the other fields
are present when the event carries them.

from.description: A transaction's state before the change.

missed.description: Events this stream fell behind by and lost: `lagged` only.

state.description: A session's or a transport listener's state.

target.description: The height a sync works towards.

to.description: A transaction's state after the change.

FinalizeBody.description: The receiver's answer to a send, or the payer's answer to an invoice.

fluff.description: Broadcast to all peers at once instead of through the stem phase.

slate.description: The answer slate, V2 or V3 slate JSON.

ForeignResponse.description: The answer: `result` to a call that was understood, `error` to one that was not.

ForeignResult.description: `Ok` with the method's answer, or `Err` with the reason the wallet refused.

HttpListenReport.description: What `http listen`, or the HTTP listener of `serve`, did before it was stopped.

repeated.description: Payments answered again with the reply stored the first time.

ImportedReport.description: What the old wallet recorded of an imported transaction.

catching_up.description:
True when the node's tip is too far above the wallet's confirmed height to be taken from
one answer, so the balances are at `height`, below the node's tip.

height.description: The chain tip the balances were computed at.

node_behind.description: True when the node is behind the last refresh, so the balances were not updated.

ListingReport.description: A listing: the service key in hex and the generation.

MaintenanceReport.description: One maintenance task of `serve`, since it started.

last_error.description: The error of the latest failure, kept after a success; `null` before any failure.

category.description: Where the output counts in the balance; none for a spent output.

lock_height.description: First height the output can be spent at, when it has one.

PasswordBody.description: The vault's password, and the one it is re-encrypted under.

Problem.description: An error, as RFC 9457 problem details (`application/problem+json`).

detail.description: The error and its causes, outermost first.

tx_id.description:
The transaction the error is about, when one was stored: a send stopped before its
delivery was known, or a `slate_id` used before.

ReceiveBody.description: A slate a sender gave this wallet.

account.description: The account the payment goes to; the default account when absent.

message.description: A message to the sender, signed with the reply.

slate.description: The slate, V2 or V3 slate JSON.

ReceiveTxRequest.description: Receive a slate; the answer is the reply slate.

params.description:
`[slate, null, null, null]`: the V2 or V3 slate object, then three entries the
wallet ignores.

ReplySlate.description: `receive_tx`: the reply slate object, in the version it was sent in.

RequestsReport.description: The API's requests since serve started.

in_flight.description: Requests being answered now; an event stream counts while it is open.

refused.description: Connections closed unanswered: over the connection cap, or from another user.

RpcError.description: A JSON-RPC error: a request that was not JSON-RPC, or a method the wallet lacks.

RpcId.description: The request's id, echoed in the answer.

account.description: The account label; the default account when absent.

amount.description: EPIC, as a decimal string, for example `"1.5"`.

change_outputs.description: Outputs the change is split into.

message.description: A message to the receiver, signed with the slate.

min_confirmations.description: Confirmations an output needs before it is spent.

slate_id.description:
A random version-4 UUID the caller stores before sending. A send made again under it
sends nothing and reports the first send with `repeated: true`.

to.description: The Epicbox address the slate goes to.

delivered.description:
Whether a delivery attempt got the slate to the other party. Only a repeat can report
`false`; `tx resend` delivers it.

destination.description: The Epicbox address, the file path or the HTTP endpoint the slate went to.

repeated.description: The send was made before under the same `--slate-id`; this run sent nothing.

state.description:
`sent`, or `posted` when the receiver answered over HTTP and the transaction was
finalized and posted in the same command. For a repeat, the first send's state now.

ServeHttpStatus.description: The HTTP listener of a running `serve --http`, with its counts so far.

ServeStatusReport.description: A running `serve`: facts only, which a monitor compares with its own thresholds.

epicbox.description:
The Epicbox listener's connection: `connecting`, `connected`, `disconnected` or
`stopped`; `null` before its first report.

height.description: The node's tip at the wallet's last refresh that applied; `null` before the first.

node_tip.description: The highest node tip the wallet confirmed; `null` before the first.

socket.description: The socket the API answers on.

SlateReceiveReport.description: A slate received through the API: the reply travels in the answer, not in a file.

repeated.description: The slate was received before; `slate` is the reply stored then.

slate.description: The reply slate to give the sender, V3 slate JSON.

coinbase.description: `true` for a mining reward: an incoming coinbase output with no slate; `tx show` only.

confirmed_height.description: Block height the transaction was confirmed at; shown by `tx show` only, when known.

oneOf.description: For an imported transaction, what the old wallet recorded; `tx show` only.

kernel_excess.description: Hex excess of the final kernel; shown by `tx show` only, when a final slate is stored.

messages.description: The parties' messages whose signatures verify; listed by `tx show` only.

oneOf.description:
For a payment received at a listing address, the service key (hex) and generation of
that listing; `tx show` only.

receiver_declined_at.description:
For a send its receiver refused unanswered, when it said so (ADR 0045); the send was
cancelled then. `tx show` only.

releasable.description: Whether `tx release` may release it now; shown by `tx show` with `releasable_from`.

releasable_from.description:
For a finalized or posted send, the height from which a refresh that still misses its
kernel makes it releasable; shown by `tx show` only.

sender_reported_cancelled_at.description:
For a received payment that is not confirmed, when its sender reported that it
cancelled it; `tx show` only.

sender_reported_posted_at.description:
For a payment received over Epicbox that waits for its sender, when the sender reported
that it posted it, within the hour after; `tx show` only.

stages.description: Slate stages stored for the transaction; listed by `tx show` only.
